verdict.rationale: CloudConvert is a file-conversion API and service, not an AI agent or host application, so plugging MCP servers into it to consume their tools is outside its product role. The evidence shows CloudConvert acting as an MCP server for ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP clients, which is the opposite role and cannot be credited here. Its AI file-processing feature (docs-19) does not mention accepting external MCP servers, so nothing flips the axis to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
